keep_hidden includes hidden elements and template text in HTTP Markdown output

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using Crawlberg;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
var engineConfig = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<CrawlConfig>("{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"never\"},\"content\":{\"extract_metadata\":false,\"keep_hidden\":true}}", ConfigOptions)!;
var engine = CrawlbergConverter.CreateEngine(engineConfig);
var url = "https://example.com";
var result = await CrawlbergConverter.ScrapeAsync(engine, url);
Console.WriteLine(result.StatusCode);
Console.WriteLine(result.Markdown!.Content);
```
